capabilities: Search games by title via the RAWG API
Create game notes from a selected note template
Sync Steam library and wishlist games into the vault
Inject Steam metadata such as playtime and steamId into game notes
Regenerate metadata of existing game notes from the template
disambiguation: Not a vault search tool; it searches the RAWG game database to create new game notes.
extras: Steam sync is described as slow for large libraries; the Steam wishlist must be set to Public for wishlist sync, and synced games keep a steamId property that should not be removed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up video game metadata or import a Steam library into game notes.

relations.evidence: uses RAWG Game API to get the game information
Optionally, you can auto-sync your Steam Library and Wishlist.
It is recommended to pair this plugin with Templater

summary: Game note creator that queries the RAWG API by title, fills notes with game metadata, and optionally syncs a Steam library and wishlist.
